.brand-mark{width:54px;height:54px;margin-bottom:25px;font-size:26px}.row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.divider{border:0;border-top:1px solid 18px;min-height:50px}.topbar-right{gap:9px}.content{padding:25px 18px 40px}.page-heading{flex-direction:column;gap:12px}h1{font-size:25px}.metrics{gap:9px}.metric{padding:15px}.metric strong{font-size:24px}.card{padding:19px}.pages-layout,.chat-layout{display:block}.page-list{max-height:170px;margin-bottom:15px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.chat-history{max-height:130px;overflow:auto;margin-bottom:15px}.build-banner{padding:10px 18px;flex-wrap:wrap}footer{padding:15px 18px}#toast{left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px}.topbar .badge{font-size:9px}}
</style>
